description: Posterior-sensitivity skew frontier for the D1 Layer-3 experiment. Reuses the prompt-10msc protocol verbatim (config meta_order_smoke, T=600 s, seeds 1..30, same HMM posterior, MarkoutHarness, matched fill RNG); sweeps posterior_sensitivity with max_skew_ticks=5.0 and the fill-logistic fixed at SkewAgentConfig defaults. Episode A (s=0.0) is the Hawkes-blind matched baseline within each seed.

fixed_skew_agent_config.note: only posterior_sensitivity is swept; all else default
